research_mode: official Police.uk API documentation only; stop-search outcome and area-query semantics; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: Stop outcome false value
verified_claims: outcome is false when nothing was found
limitations: false must not be converted to missing data

sources.name: Stop outcome empty value
verified_claims: outcome is an empty string when no outcome was provided
limitations: empty string and false have different meanings

sources.name: Outcome-to-object link
limitations: the flag describes linkage, not legal sufficiency

sources.name: Missing outcome linkage
verified_claims: outcome linkage can be null when not provided
limitations: null must not be converted to false

sources.name: Outer-clothing removal flag
limitations: the field is not a general intrusiveness score

sources.name: Missing outer-clothing flag
verified_claims: outer-clothing removal can be null when not provided
limitations: null must not be interpreted as no removal

sources.name: Stop-search point radius
verified_claims: a point query returns stops within a one-mile radius
limitations: radius results are not exact-point observations

sources.name: Stop-search custom polygon
verified_claims: the area endpoint accepts a custom polygon

sources.name: Polygon coordinate format
verified_claims: poly uses latitude-longitude pairs separated by colons

sources.name: Automatic polygon closure
verified_claims: first and last coordinates need not match
the API joins them with a straight line
limitations: automatic closure can alter intended complex boundaries

sources.name: GET request length limit
verified_claims: GET requests longer than 4094 characters return status 400
limitations: request failure is not evidence of no stops

sources.name: POST for complex polygons
verified_claims: POST is recommended for particularly complex polygon parameters
limitations: HTTP method choice does not change anonymisation

sources.name: Area-query default month
verified_claims: date is optional for point and polygon queries
the latest month is returned by default
limitations: latest available month can lag current time

sources.name: Area-query location approximation
verified_claims: area-query stop locations are approximate rather than exact
limitations: coordinates cannot verify an exact address or parcel

sources.name: Stop-search parcel-use guard
verified_claims: published location semantics support area context only
limitations: no parcel-level candidate can be derived from anonymised stop coordinates
